name: Paradip Port
notes: Thermal-coal berth constraints aligned to Paradip Port Authority: up to 300m LOA, 46m beam, 14.5m draft at multiple coal berths.

name: Visakhapatnam (Vizag)
notes: Inner harbor restricted to Panamax. Outer harbor can take larger drafts.

name: Gangavaram Port
notes: Deepest port on the East Coast. Capesize standard berthing.

name: Gopalpur Port
notes: Mainly Supramax and Handysize. Upgrades in progress.

name: Dhamra Port
notes: Deep draft. Well connected, handles Cape size and Panamax.

name: Sagar-Sandheads
notes: Mainly lighterage operations. High swell risks.

name: Haldia Dock Complex
notes: Severe river draft restrictions. Requires tide assistance.
